name: Inran Ojou-sama ~Nakadashi no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 淫乱お嬢様～中出しの誘惑～
source:
Kei is a butler. One day, Kaori, a girl who is a daughter of his master, suddenly gets interested in erotic things and starts approaching him! Kei hasn't had sex yet, but he gradually gets addicted to it....

[From ErogeShop]
